source_verification.tracking_scope: Workspace Rust sources, tests and examples, all nine crate Cargo manifests, workspace Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock; separate data fixture and executable reports retain their own provenance.

isolated_native_demo_revalidation.reason: Final small-viewport/150%-text native passes identified footer layout and nested inspector focus reveal defects. Their tested source inputs remain unchanged. The demo tests, native executable and final formatting gate are revalidated after the isolated UI polish.

counting_policy: One complete final non-Bevy workspace gate. Each successful (crate, harness, case) appears once. Targeted reruns, Bevy/demo tests, examples, process smoke checks, historical reports and empty doctest harnesses add no cases.
scope: Bounded correctness and actual localhost TCP/TLS/SQLite fixtures, including warehouse reservation/conservation, source support, semantic input limits, queue backpressure, closed-host provisioning and recovery. No GPU, Internet-service, real-device or distributed-MMO capacity claim.
